crossRefs.note: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also…

translations.web: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
translations.bsb: And I said, “Wisdom is better than strength, but the wisdom of the poor man is despised, and his words are not heeded.”
translations.kjv: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
translations.asv: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
